# rustinion_group_restart_policy (Resource)

Manages a group's restart policy: automatic restart (never / in_window / as_soon_as_needed), install and restart windows, rings, max at once, and coordinated (rolling) restarts with drain and verify hooks. The policy is a JSON object (use jsonencode) with the keys of PUT /api/v1/customer/groups/{id}/restart-policy, e.g. `{auto_restart = "in_window", restart_window = [{days = [0,1,2,3,4,5,6], start_minute = 60, end_minute = 300}], max_concurrent = 1, drain_hooks = [{kind = "stop_services", units = ["forgejo-runner*.service"]}], verify_hooks = [{kind = "mounted", paths = ["/nfs-home"]}], drain_timeout_minutes = 180}`. Absent keys use the built-in defaults. See https://rustinion.com/rolling-restarts.html. Destroying the resource sets the policy back to `{"auto_restart":"never"}`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group this policy belongs to.
- `policy_json` (String) The whole restart policy as a JSON object (jsonencode). The server validates it (windows, hook syntax, timeouts) and rejects invalid values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
- `paused` (String) Why the group's restarts are paused (a device didn't come back or isn't healthy after a coordinated restart), empty while they run. Resume on the group's Restarts page.
